scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: for f in .env src/frontend/.env; do [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" ] && [ ! -e "$f" ] && cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" "$f"; done; true

scripts.name: Stack up (Docker)
scripts.command: p=$((20000 + $(basename "$PWD" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 500 * 20)); slug=$(basename "$PWD" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr -c 'a-z0-9-\n' '-'); export WORKTREE="$PWD" COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="langflow-$slug" BACKEND_PORT=$p FRONTEND_PORT=$((p+1)); c() { docker compose -f "$HOME/.claude/skills/langflow/docker/compose.yml" "$@"; }; docker volume create langflow-agent-uv-cache >/dev/null; docker volume create langflow-agent-npm-cache >/dev/null; docker image inspect langflow-agent-base >/dev/null 2>&1 || c build; echo "==> backend http://localhost:$p  frontend http://localhost:$((p+1))"; c up -d --wait --wait-timeout 900 && c logs -f

scripts.name: Stack down (Docker)
scripts.command: p=$((20000 + $(basename "$PWD" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 500 * 20)); slug=$(basename "$PWD" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr -c 'a-z0-9-\n' '-'); export WORKTREE="$PWD" COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="langflow-$slug" BACKEND_PORT=$p FRONTEND_PORT=$((p+1)); c() { docker compose -f "$HOME/.claude/skills/langflow/docker/compose.yml" "$@"; }; c down -v
